title: Democratizing Ethical Assessment of Natural Language Generation Models
findings: A larger proportion of texts generated from prompts related to Islam, Judaism, and Christianity were classified as insulting, profane, threatening, and toxic compared to other religious groups. The paper also identified performance disparities across demographic groups, indicating fairness issues.
references: Abubakar Abid, Maheen Farooqi, and James Zou. 2021. Large language models associate Muslims with violence. Nature Machine Intelligence 3, 6 (2021), 461-463.
